title: Enhancing the energy storage capacity of a symmetric supercapacitor employing α-Cu2P2O7 produced by a template-based co-precipitation approach

Pyrophosphates have acquired considerable attention as a potential electrode material in energy storage devices owing to their strong covalent P–O bonds, which ensure structural stability, high electrochemical activity, and efficient ion migration.
